page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:8 ratio of processing cores to memory, the instance provides 512.0 GB of RAM, translating to 8.0 GB of memory per core.

The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that processing resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent compute performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per core makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of additional compute licensing. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
